Round 4: identified as daughter of Caleb Smith 2d (4C7R).

bio: Wife of Major Ebenezer Smith (1795-1879); daughter of Caleb Smith 2d (Pelletreau, [R4-S1]), so herself a Bull Smith descendant: Bull -> Daniel -> Daniel 2d -> Caleb -> Caleb 2d -> Sarah (5 generations; 4C7R). Their sons were Ethelbert M. and Caleb T. Smith.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 477 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
